name: Henry II of France
contribution: King of France from 1547 until his death in 1559.
image_credit: Workshop of François Clouet · Public domain

checks.lead: Henry II (French: Henri II; 31 March 1519 – 10 July 1559) was King of France from 1547 until his death in 1559. The second son of Francis I and Claude, Duchess of Brittany, he became Dauphin of France upon the death of his elder brother Francis in 1536.
